title: phUSD mint authority is load-bearing for solvency; revocation, pause, or supply cap bricks claim/stake/withdraw without graceful degradation
description: _claimRewards unconditionally calls phUSD.mint(user, pendingPhUSDAmount) whenever pendingPhUSDAmount > 0. If the sibling phUSD contract revokes Phlimbo's mint privilege (documented kill switch revokeAllMintPrivileges), pauses minting, or hits a supply cap, every claim/stake/withdraw entrypoint with non-zero pending phUSD reverts. There is no try/catch, no fallback that skips the phUSD mint while still settling the stable component, and no graceful-degradation path documented.
impact: If phUSD's mint authority is revoked or otherwise made unavailable, all stakers with non-zero pendingPhUSD are permanently locked out of claim/stake/withdraw. The only escape is pauseWithdraw (which requires pauser cooperation) and forfeits all accrued rewards. Trigger is a sibling-contract action, not this contract's owner — does NOT fall under the C4 'reckless admin' exclusion at this contract's owner level.
attackPath: phUSD governance invokes revokeAllMintPrivileges() OR pauses minting OR hits a supply cap.
Any user with pendingPhUSD > 0 calls claim/stake/withdraw.
Entire entrypoint reverts; user cannot exit normally.
Only escape is pauseWithdraw (forfeits all rewards) during a future pause.
likelihood: medium — depends on a cross-contract operational event at phUSD; phUSD has revokeAllMintPrivileges as a documented kill switch
assumptions: phUSD sibling triggers a minting failure (revocation, pause, cap, or blacklist); KI-7 acknowledges the dependency but not the absence of graceful degradation
externalRequirements: Sibling-contract action (governance of phUSD), not this owner
recommendation: Wrap the phUSD.mint call in a try/catch and either (a) skip the phUSD leg while still settling stable rewards on revert and emit a PhUSDMintFailed(user, pending) event, or (b) accumulate the un-mintable phUSD in a per-user owedPhUSD ledger so users can be made whole later. Option (a) preserves the documented exit path for stable rewards while the operational issue is resolved.

poc.notes: PoC: deploy mock phUSD whose mint() reverts, accumulate pending rewards on a user, then assert claim/stake/withdraw all revert with the mock's revert reason. To be authored by poc-generator.

classifierRationale: No graceful degradation when sibling phUSD revokes/pauses minting. External requirement (sibling action) is stated. Medium fits.
